chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked him about a man washing his wife. He said: Yes, from behind the garment.

key_terms.الثَّوْبِ: the garment or cloth covering the body

ai.seo_question: Can a man wash his wife after death in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a husband washing his wife. It indicates that this is permitted when done from behind a garment, and it falls within the jurisprudence of family and ritual handling of the deceased.
